# Organize taxa names by hierarchy
```{r}
taxamatch <- bind_rows(am_2021_5, am_2023_2, am_2024_2,
                       am_2024_3, am_2024_4, am_2024_5) %>% 
  group_by(object_annotation_category, object_annotation_hierarchy) %>% 
   summarise(nimages = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(object_annotation_hierarchy) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = "") %>% 
  # Separate living and non living to exclude
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("not-living", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Exclude-nonliving", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("other|oversegmented|temporary", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Exclude-living", taxagroup)) %>% 
  # Identify Rhizaria and other major groups
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Rhizaria", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Rhizaria", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Mollusca", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Mollusca", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Echinodermata", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Echinodermata", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Cnidaria", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Cnidaria", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Ctenophora", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Ctenophora", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Chaetognatha", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Chaetognatha", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Tunicata", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Tunicata", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Annelida", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Annelida", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Eumalacostraca", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Eumalacostraca", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Ostracoda", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Ostracoda", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Copepoda", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Copepoda", taxagroup)) %>%
  # Mark images categorized as with visible lipid sac
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("with visible lipid sac", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Copepoda-lipidsac", taxagroup)) %>% 
  # Bulk the rest of crustacea parts and fish as Exclude-living
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(taxagroup == "", "Exclude-living", taxagroup))


taxamatch %>% 
  mutate(totalimgs = sum(nimages)) %>% 
  group_by(taxagroup, totalimgs) %>% 
  summarise(nimages = sum(nimages),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(percent = round(nimages / totalimgs * 100,2)) %>% 
  arrange(-nimages)

# Percent of copepod images classified as with lipid sac: 
# 6075/(6075+670296)*100 = 0.9%
```



# Combine all data
Filter only the living portion
```{r, eval=FALSE}
Amund_UVP6 <- bind_rows(am_2021_5, am_2023_2, am_2024_2,
                        am_2024_3, am_2024_4, am_2024_5) %>% 
  left_join(taxamatch %>% select(object_annotation_category, taxagroup),
            by = "object_annotation_category") %>% 
  filter(taxagroup != "Exclude-nonliving")%>% 
  filter(taxagroup != "Exclude-living") 

# TODO rename morphotraits?
# Major = object_major, Minor = object_minor, Perim. = object_perim.,
#          Feret = object_feret, Area = object_area, Elongation = object_elongation,
#          Ver.Sym. = object_symetriev, Ver.Sym.2 = object_symetrievc, 
#          Circ. = object_circ., Thickr = object_thickr, 
#          Mean.grey = object_mean, Med.grey = object_median,
#          `Hist.grey 75%` = object_histcum3, 
#          Sdev.grey = object_stddev, Skew.grey = object_skew,
#          Fractal = object_fractal, 
#          `Perim./Feret` = object_perimferet,
#          `Perim./Major` = object_perimmajor

# Correct some metadata errors
Amund_UVP6 <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(object_lon = if_else(sample_stationid == "LSea-23",
                              -abs(object_lon), object_lon))

# TODO include the ECOPART information

# Add the volume per 5m bin information from ECOPART
ecopart_2021_5 <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/ECOPART/export_reduced_20250311_16_52_darkedge2021/export_reduced_20250311_volumes.tsv",  header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>% 
  # Rename sample_id and Depth_5m to clearly specify bin size
  rename(sample_id = Profile, Depth_5m = Depth_m) %>% 
  select(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  # convert volume in L to m3
  mutate(Sampled_volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_L * 0.001)
ecopart_2023_2 <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/ECOPART/export_reduced_20250311_16_40_Amudsen2023/export_reduced_20250311_volumes.tsv",  header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>% 
  rename(sample_id = Profile, Depth_5m = Depth_m) %>% 
  select(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  # convert volume in L to m3
  mutate(Sampled_volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_L * 0.001)

Ecopart_UVP6 <- bind_rows(ecopart_2021_5, ecopart_2023_2)

Ecopart_UVP6_totalVolume <- Ecopart_UVP6 %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(maxDepth = max(Depth_5m),
            volume_L = sum(Sampled_volume_L),
            volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            .groups = "drop")

# Match sample to volume (+- 2.5)
Amund_UVP6 <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max / 5)*5+2.5) %>% 
  left_join(Ecopart_UVP6,
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m))
```


# Explore sampling metadata
Note that there may be multiple casts in the same station
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# TODO need to get actual station depths for filtering "shallow" stations

Amund_UVP6_meta <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  # Calculate deepest sample depth
  mutate(nimages = n(),
         maxSampleDepth = max(object_depth_max)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(-c(object_depth_max:Sampled_volume_m3)) %>% 
  # Add total volume info
  left_join(Ecopart_UVP6_totalVolume, by = join_by(sample_id)) %>% 
  # Establish DOY, Year
  mutate(Year = year(object_date),
         Month = month(object_date),
         DOY = yday(object_date))



# Establish Twilight (UTC dates provided?) based on solar angle for the date with SunTools
# Note that in summer, may be all during daytime
df.twilight <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  select(sample_id, object_lon, object_lat, object_date, object_time, 
         Year, Month, DOY) %>% 
  mutate(fullDate = as.POSIXct(paste(object_date, object_time),
                                     tz = "UTC")) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(dawn = crepuscule(matrix(c(object_lon, object_lat), nrow = 1),
                           fullDate,
                           solarDep = 6,
                           direction = "dawn",
                           POSIXct.out = TRUE)) %>%

  mutate(dusk = crepuscule(matrix(c(object_lon, object_lat), nrow = 1),
                           fullDate,
                           solarDep = 6,
                           direction = "dusk",
                           POSIXct.out = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(sunrise = sunriset(matrix(c(object_lon, object_lat), nrow = 1),
                           fullDate,
                           direction = "sunrise",
                           POSIXct.out = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(sunset = sunriset(matrix(c(object_lon, object_lat), nrow = 1),
                           fullDate,
                           direction = "sunset",
                           POSIXct.out = TRUE)) %>% 
  # TODO Decide what to assign as night/day
  mutate(twilight = if_else(fullDate >= dawn$time & fullDate < dusk$time,
                            "Day", ""),
         twilight = if_else(fullDate >= dusk$time | fullDate < dawn$time,
                            "Night", twilight)) %>% 
  # If NA during August at high latitude, that indicates day time
  mutate(twilight = if_else(is.na(twilight), "Day", twilight))

# Confirm twilight assignment
ggplot(Amund_UVP6_meta, aes(x = DOY, y = object_time, color = twilight,
                            shape = as.factor(Year))) +
  geom_point() +
  ylab("Time (UTC)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(182,213,244,274,305),
                     labels = c("Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov"))

# Assign twilight in data frames
Amund_UVP6_meta <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  left_join(df.twilight %>% select(sample_id, twilight),
            by = "sample_id")
Amund_UVP6 <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  left_join(df.twilight %>% select(sample_id, twilight),
            by = "sample_id")
```


# Metadata plots
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Are there more images when casts are deeper or volume sampled was higher?
cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% filter(maxDepth > 0), 
         aes(x = maxDepth, y = nimages)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm"),
  ggplot(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% filter(maxDepth > 0), 
         aes(x = volume_L, y = nimages)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm")
)


# Map samples
basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-90,-50,64,83), rotate = T,
        legends = FALSE) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
                                  filter(object_lat > 62), 
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat, 
                                    # shape = Year,
                                    color = maxSampleDepth),
                                size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Depth (m)", trans = "log10") +
  # scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24), guide = "none") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position="top", title.hjust = 0.5))

# Plot by year and DOY
basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-90,-50,64,83), rotate = T, bathy.style = "contour_blues",
        legends = FALSE) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
                                  filter(object_lat > 62) %>% 
                                  mutate(Month = as.factor(Month)), 
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat, 
                                    shape = Month,
                                    fill = DOY),
                                size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,22,23,24), labels = c("Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct")) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "DOY", option = "turbo", direction = -1,
                       breaks = c(182,213,244,274,305),
                       labels = c("Jul 1","Aug 1","Sep 1","Oct 1","Nov 1")) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position="top", title.hjust = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~Year)


ggsave("figures/stations_by_date.png",
       height = 5, width = 9, units = "in", bg = "white")

# General distribution of all samples with bottome depth 
basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = TRUE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-90,-53,49,83), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "#eeeac4",  bathy.style = "poly_blues",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
                                  # filter(object_lat > 62) %>% 
                                  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year)),
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat, 
                                    shape = Year, color = Year, size = Year),
                                alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("hotpink","gold3","purple2"), name = "Year") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,17,18), name = "Year") +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(3,2,2), guide = "none") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12))+ 
  guides(color  = guide_legend(order = 1),
         shape  = guide_legend(order = 1),
         fill = guide_legend(order = 2))


ggsave("figures/stations_bathy.png",
       height = 9, width = 8, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

# Deprecated scripts
## Old method for organizing taxa names
Note that in this approach, taxa marked as dead/house are considered nonliving
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Organize to major groups
taxamatch <- tibble(object_annotation_category = 
                      c(am_2021_5$object_annotation_category,
                        am_2023_2$object_annotation_category,
                        am_2024_2$object_annotation_category,
                        am_2024_3$object_annotation_category,
                        am_2024_4$object_annotation_category,
                        am_2024_5$object_annotation_category)) %>% 
  group_by(object_annotation_category) %>% 
  summarise(nimages = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(object_annotation_category) %>% 
  mutate(taxaname = object_annotation_category) %>% 
  
  mutate(taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Copepoda<Maxillopoda"),
                        "Copepoda", taxaname),
         taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("side<with visible lipid sac",
                                            "top-bottom<with visible lipid sac"),
                            "Calanus-lipid", taxaname),
         taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Cnidaria<Metazoa", "Cnidaria X"),
                            "Cnidaria", taxaname),
         taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Ctenophora X", "Ctenophora<Metazoa"),
                            "Ctenophora", taxaname),
         taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("larvae<Echinodermata"),
                            "Echinodermata", taxaname)) %>% 
  # Excluded nonliving and living
  mutate(taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("t001","t002","t003","t005","t007"),
                            "Exclude-nonliving", taxaname),
          taxaname = if_else(grepl(c("detritus|feces|dead|artefact|sphere|crystal|turbid|reflection|bubble|badfocus|othertocheck|dark|fecal pellets|house|fiber"),
                                  taxaname) == TRUE,
                            "Exclude-nonliving", taxaname),
         taxaname = if_else(grepl(c("egg|antenna|tentacle|part|over segmented|oversegmented|Actinopterygii|solitary|colonial|spiky|fish"),
                                  taxaname) == TRUE,
                            "Exclude-living", taxaname),
         
         taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("rhizaria like (Deprecated)",
                                            "like<Rhizaria","veliger<Mollusca",
                                            "Chordata","Polychaeta","Mollusca"),
                            "Exclude-living", taxaname),
         taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Collodaria","Medusettidae","rhizaria","Rhizaria",
                                            "Aulacanthidae","Aulophaeridae","Cannosphaeridae",
                                            "Aulosphaeridae","Coelodendridae","Coelographis",
                                            "Foraminifera"),
                            "Rhizaria", taxaname)) %>% 

  
  mutate(taxagroup = taxaname) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Calanus","Calanus-lipid", "Calanoida",
                                             "Metridia","Paraeuchaeta",
                                             "Oncaeidae","Heterorhabdidae",
                                             "Heterorhabdus",
                                             "Harpacticoida", "Cyclopoida"),
                             "Copepoda", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Hyperiidea","Themisto"),
                             "Amphipoda", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Crustacea","Eumalacostraca",
                                            "Isopoda","Cumacea",
                                            "Euphausiacea larvae"),
                             "Crustaceans", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Beroe abyssicola","Cydippida",
                                             "Beroe cucumis", "Mertensia ovum",
                                             "Lobata", "Beroe"),
                             "Ctenophora", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Limacinidae","Clionidae","Limacina",
                                             "Limacina helicina"),
                             "Pteropoda", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Eukrohnia"),
                             "Chaetognatha", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Phyllodocida","Swima","Poeobius"),
                             "Annelida", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Salpida","Appendicularia"),
                             "Tunicata", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Euphysa","Halitholus",
                                             "Aeginopsis","Aglantha digitale",
                                             "Botrynema ellinorae",
                                             "Solmundella bitentaculata",
                                             "Aeginidae", "Botrynema",
                                             "Hydrozoa",
                                             "Hydromedusae","Siphonophorae"),
                             "Cnidaria", taxagroup))


```
